criterion: With GIS open, Search layers empty, and the permitted setup complete, the catalogue visibly contains Surveyor and the tester has recorded the complete loaded Map layers entries and their order as the pre-search baseline.
steps_taken: Navigated to the exact launcher URL and captured this criterion's visible launcher initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for the map to settle. Search layers was empty; no pre-existing loaded layers or Map layers list were present.
Opened Surveyor's Add layer dialog; retained defaults (Active layer Service, Date range Last 30 days, no selected survey or additional filters), and added exactly one temporary layer.
Recorded the complete post-setup Map layers baseline in order: [Surveyor - Service], the sole test-owned layer.
Recorded the unfiltered catalogue with Surveyor (1) visible and Search layers empty; captured decisive final state and its GIS URL.
Removed only the sole test-created Surveyor - Service layer; verified the original empty loaded-layer state was restored.
observedResult: Surveyor (1) was visibly present in the unfiltered catalogue. Search layers was empty. The complete loaded-layer baseline was exactly one test-created Surveyor - Service layer.
cleanup: Removed only the criterion's test-created layer; original empty loaded-layer state restored.
